tools.name: search_trips
tools.description: Search 2,000+ Virtuoso hotels, plus packages, cruises and private experiences, by place, brand or kind of stay. Results show whether Virtuoso perks apply, a trip_id for get_trip_details, and how to book. No live rates: the advisor quotes them.

tools.name: get_trip_details
tools.description: Get the details of a hotel, package, cruise or private experience from search_trips, with a hotel's Virtuoso perks. Virtuoso records carry no published rate or availability; the advisor quotes those in writing within 24 hours.

tools.name: check_complexity
tools.description: Check whether a request goes straight to Geisel Power, the Virtuoso advisor, for a quote (hotel stays always do).

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Get the steps to book a hotel, cruise or experience found with search_trips. Geisel Power, the Virtuoso advisor, quotes it in writing within 24 hours (rate, taxes, the hotel's cancellation policy and the perks) and books only after the traveler approves. This tool sends nothing itself (request_sent:

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Check the status of an existing booking

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking request. A confirmed hotel reservation is cancelled with the hotel under its own cancellation policy, which comes with the quote and the confirmation.

tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: WRITE. Ask Geisel Power, the Virtuoso advisor, to price a stay at a Virtuoso hotel (property_id from search_trips). Virtuoso data carries no live rates, so pricing is asynchronous: this returns a quote id with status "pending" and a quote_due_by time (within 24 hours); poll get_availability_quote. A

tools.name: get_availability_quote
tools.description: READ. Returns the status of a quote from search_availability: "pending" (try again later), "quoted" (offers with stay_id, full total, cancellation terms), "unavailable", or "expired". Use an offer's stay_id with create_booking_session.

tools.name: create_booking_session
tools.description: WRITE. Opens a UCP lodging booking session from a quoted offer (stay_id from get_availability_quote). Returns the authoritative total, the cancellation policy (show it to the traveler), the Virtuoso amenities, the payment term (pay at the hotel) and evidence. Nothing is charged; the session is held

tools.name: get_booking_session
tools.description: READ. Current state of a booking session: ready_for_complete (awaiting the traveler's approval), complete_in_progress (the advisor is placing the reservation), completed (includes the hotel's own confirmation number; the traveler is also emailed), or canceled.

tools.name: update_booking_session
tools.description: WRITE. Change occupancy (within the quote) or set the booker before completing. Not allowed after completion.

tools.name: complete_booking_session
tools.description: SENSITIVE WRITE — get the traveler's explicit approval of the full total and the hotel's cancellation policy first. Asks Geisel Power to place the reservation. No payment is taken: the traveler pays the hotel directly under its own terms, and hotel bookings carry no fee. Returns complete_in_progress

tools.name: cancel_booking_session
tools.description: SENSITIVE WRITE. Withdraws a booking before the hotel confirms it (the advisor is told). Confirmed reservations are cancelled with the hotel under its cancellation policy, through the advisor.
